# ui::TrayIcon

Header: `winui/ui/TrayIcon.hpp`.

An icon in the taskbar's notification area, with a hover text, a right-click menu and notifications. It is only the icon. The app runs its own loop ([ui::run()](namespace-ui.md#run)) and ends it with [ui::quit()](namespace-ui.md#quit). A flyout is an ordinary [Window](window.md) the app owns and attaches through [TrayIconOptions::flyout](tray-icon-options.md).

The icon is added when the TrayIcon is created and removed when it is destroyed. UI thread only.

Example: 
```cpp
int main()
{
    ui::Property<float> volume{40.0f};

    ui::Window flyout{ui::tray_flyout_options({.title = "Volume", .width = 320.0f})};
    flyout.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
        .spacing  = 16.0f,
        .margin   = ui::Thickness{20.0f},
        .content  = {ui::Slider{.value = volume}},
    });

    ui::TrayIcon tray{{
        .tool_tip = "Volume",
        .icon     = ui::WindowIcon{.glyph = ui::IconGlyph{0xE767}},
        .menu     = {{.text = "Open", .on_click = [&] { tray.show_flyout(); }},
                    {.text = "Quit", .on_click = [] { ui::quit(); }}},
        .flyout  = &flyout,
    }};
    return ui::run(); // until ui::quit(); closing the flyout only hides it
}
```

## TrayIcon

```cpp
TrayIcon(TrayIconOptions options = {})
```

Adds the icon. When there is no taskbar yet, the icon is added as soon as the taskbar starts.

## notify

```cpp
void notify(Notification notification)
```

Shows a notification from the icon. It is what [ui::notify()](namespace-ui.md#notify) shows, sent with the tray icon as its source, so NotificationIcon::App is the tray icon. The user's notification settings decide whether it is shown. Replaces one still showing. A click runs `notification.on_click`, or [TrayIconOptions::on_notification_click](tray-icon-options.md) when that is empty.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::TrayIcon tray{{.tool_tip = "Timer"}};
tray.notify({.title = "Timer", .text = "Time is up.", .on_click = [&] { tray.show_flyout(); }});
```

## show_flyout

```cpp
void show_flyout()
```

Open the flyout next to the icon, sized to its content, and give it the focus. Does nothing without a flyout.

## hide_flyout

```cpp
void hide_flyout()
```

Hide the flyout. It is not destroyed, so its content and state stay.

## toggle_flyout

```cpp
void toggle_flyout()
```

[show_flyout()](#show_flyout) if hidden, [hide_flyout()](#hide_flyout) if open: what a click on the icon does.
